sentences.text:
Counsel for Applicant :- Surendra Singh,Brijendra Kumar Verma Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Shree Prakash Singh,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, the learned AGA for the State and perused the material placed on record.

By means of the instant application, the applicant has prayed that this Court be pleased to direct the learned Court below not to insist the petitioner to file surety bond in each and every five cases and accept only two sureties in lieu of all the five cases.
The learned counsel appearing for the applicant submits that it has become impossible for the applicant to submit surety in each of case in which he has been granted bail.

He added that the applicant has been granted bail in four cases arising out of following Case Crime Numbers :-
1) Case Crime No. 412 of 2021, under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471 of the IPC, PS Deva,
District Barabanki.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 3) Case Crime No. 725 of 2022, under Sections 419, 420, 467, 468, 471 of the IPC PS Deva, District Barabanki.
4) Case Crime No. 726 of 2022, under Sections 419, 420, 467, 468, 471 of the IPC PS Deva, District Barabanki.
He next added that despite the Trial Court granted the bail, the applicant is still in jail and the applicant being poor person is unable to produce the sureties in each cases.

It is further submitted by the learned counsel for the applicant that in similar circumstances, namely, in the case of Hani Nishad @ Mohammad Imran @ Vikky vs. The State of Uttar Pradesh [SLP (Crl.)
No.8914-8915/2018] the Supreme Court vide order dated 29.10.2018 has permitted the petitioner to submit personal bonds and two sureties of heavy amount to hold good in all the cases.

entities.text:
Hani Nishad @ Mohammad Imran @ Vikky vs. The State of Uttar Pradesh [SLP (Crl.)
No.8914-8915/2018]
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Considering the aforesaid fact, the petition is disposed off with a direction to the applicant to furnish a personal bond of Rs.1,00,000/- and two sureties of the like amount in one case, which shall be treated to be valid in all other cases wherein the bail orders have been passed.
